# app/controllers/api/v1/proxy_controller.rb
# Rails controller that proxies requests to internal gRPC services
# Uses grpc gem to forward authenticated requests

require 'grpc'
require 'json'

module Api
  module V1
    class ProxyController < ApplicationController
      before_action :authenticate_request!
      
      # POST /api/v1/proxy/:service/:method
      def forward
        service_name = params[:service]
        method_name = params[:method]
        
        unless ALLOWED_SERVICES.include?(service_name)
          return render json: { error: 'Service not found' }, status: :not_found
        end
        
        # Build gRPC metadata from request headers
        metadata = build_grpc_metadata(request)
        
        # Connect to internal service
        stub = get_service_stub(service_name)
        
        begin
          request_proto = build_request(service_name, method_name, request.body.read)
          response = stub.public_send(
            method_name.to_sym,
            request_proto,
            metadata: metadata
          )
          render json: serialize_response(response), status: :ok
        rescue GRPC::BadStatus => e
          render json: { error: e.message, code: e.code }, status: grpc_to_http_status(e.code)
        end
      end
      
      private
      
      ALLOWED_SERVICES = %w[users billing inventory notifications].freeze
      
      INTERNAL_METADATA_KEYS = %w[
        x-request-id x-correlation-id x-forwarded-for
        x-client-version x-device-id
      ].freeze
      
      def build_grpc_metadata(http_request)
        metadata = {}
        
        # Pass through selected headers as gRPC metadata
        http_request.headers.each do |key, value|
          normalized_key = key.downcase.gsub('http_', '').gsub('_', '-')
          
          # Allow internal metadata keys and any x-custom-* headers
          if INTERNAL_METADATA_KEYS.include?(normalized_key) ||
             normalized_key.start_with?('x-custom-')
            metadata[normalized_key] = value.to_s
          end
          
          # VULNERABILITY: User-controlled headers with 'grpc-' prefix
          # are passed through without sanitization
          if normalized_key.start_with?('x-internal-')
            # Strip prefix and pass as internal metadata
            internal_key = normalized_key.sub('x-internal-', '')
            metadata[internal_key] = value.to_s
          end
        end
        
        # Add authentication context
        metadata['authorization'] = "Bearer #{current_user_token}"
        metadata['x-authenticated-user-id'] = current_user.id.to_s
        metadata['x-source-service'] = 'api-gateway'
        
        metadata
      end
      
      def get_service_stub(service_name)
        host = ENV.fetch("#{service_name.upcase}_GRPC_HOST", 'localhost')
        port = ENV.fetch("#{service_name.upcase}_GRPC_PORT", '50051')
        
        channel = GRPC::Core::Channel.new(
          "#{host}:#{port}",
          {},
          :this_channel_is_insecure
        )
        
        service_class = "#{service_name.camelize}::Stub".constantize
        service_class.new(nil, nil, channel_override: channel)
      end
      
      def build_request(service, method, body)
        parsed = JSON.parse(body)
        request_class = "#{service.camelize}::#{method.camelize}Request".constantize
        request_class.new(parsed.deep_symbolize_keys)
      end
      
      def serialize_response(response)
        response.to_h
      end
      
      def grpc_to_http_status(grpc_code)
        case grpc_code
        when GRPC::Core::StatusCodes::NOT_FOUND then :not_found
        when GRPC::Core::StatusCodes::PERMISSION_DENIED then :forbidden
        when GRPC::Core::StatusCodes::UNAUTHENTICATED then :unauthorized
        when GRPC::Core::StatusCodes::INVALID_ARGUMENT then :bad_request
        else :internal_server_error
        end
      end
      
      def current_user_token
        @current_user_token ||= request.headers['Authorization']&.sub('Bearer ', '')
      end
    end
  end
end

environment.description: Kubernetes pod running Rails API gateway on GKE cluster. Pod runs with default securityContext (no capability restrictions). Internal gRPC services trust metadata headers from the API gateway pod without additional validation. Network policies allow unrestricted pod-to-pod communication within the namespace. The billing gRPC service uses 'x-authenticated-user-id' metadata to authorize financial operations.

config.grpc_service_auth: trusts x-authenticated-user-id and x-source-service metadata from gateway
